{"verdict": "uncertain", "reason": "The only evidence is one line of the Prisma schema (apps/web/prisma/schema/schema.prisma:14) that adds an optional, unique email field to a model. This shows the app stores personal contact data, and on its own it looks like the positive example: a model with an email field and nothing else. But RIG-03 is about a missing grievance redressal mechanism, and that can only be confirmed by checking the whole codebase. The negative example shows that a complaints or grievance endpoint elsewhere makes this kind of finding a false positive. The evidence includes no routes, API handlers or wider app context, and the data_flow is empty. The rule is also written for Express, while this is a Prisma schema in a web app that may use another framework, so the rule's pattern may not fit. A single schema line can't show whether a grievance mechanism or published contact point exists, so the evidence is not enough to confirm or reject the finding.", "citations": ["DPDP-Act-8(10)", "DPDP-Act-13", "DPDP-Rule-14(3)"]}
